Commentary.Commentary: Now then, there is around 30 minutes left in the day's play, Australia would be eager to take a couple of wickets. England, on the other hand, will look to end the day unscathed. An important passage of play awaits ahead, especially for the hosts.

The England bowlers started in excellent fashion as Broad and Archer ran through the top order. They though looked clueless against Smith and also, after the opening burst by the two new ball bowlers, their attack seemed toothless.

The intentions were quite clear from the start of this session that Australia were looking for quick runs. Smith and Wade played their shots throughout and added a 100-plus run stand. Both though fell one after the other with Smith once again finishing as the top scorer for the visitors. Paine then walked in and started hitting the ball to the boundary but all of a sudden, he decided to give an opportunity to England to bat.

Well, that came as a complete surprise, Australia DECLARE out of nowhere. Not sure what made Paine take that decision but they have probably batted England out of the game here. The hosts have been given a target of 383.
On the pads of Starc, he tries to flick this one but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball rolls towards the leg side and the batters take one.
A single now as Paine pulls it through square leg for one.

NOT OUT! There was a huge gap between bat and ball. Not sure why the review was taken. A short one down the leg side, Paine looks to pull but misses. Bairstow appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Root reviews at the end but replays show nothing. Also, this ball has been wided by the umpire as it is too high.
Review time! Don't think there was anything on it as an appeal for a caught behind has been turned down.
WIDE! Way too wide outside off, it is left alone.
Just over and another two! Shorter and on middle, Paine comes down the track. He once again mistimes the stroke. It goes over the outstretched hand of Roy at covers.
A couple now! Paine slaps this towards cover. Roy dives to his left, gets a hand to it, can't stop two though.
Easy run as Starc opens the face of the bat and guides it through covers.
Craig Overton into the attack now.
One more short one on middle, it is ducked under.
FOUR! Dealing in boundaries is Paine. This is short and on middle, Paine goes back and pulls it nicely through mid-wicket. It is a well-controlled pull shot.
Shorter and on middle, Paine mistimes his pull to mid on.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Fuller and on off, Paine pushes it to mid off.
This is on the pads, Starc works it on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Reverse swept by Paine and this time he connects it properly as the ball races towards the third man fence.
Paine defends this tossed up delivery back towards the bowler.
That ball has taken the inside edge of Paine's bat and thudded into his pads.
FOUR! Another boundary! This is shortish and outside off, Paine goes onto the back foot and slaps it through extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Floated on middle and off, Paine lofts this one over mid on and past the long on fence for a boundary.

Spin for Leach but missed by Starc and Bairstow too. He pitches this one outside off and gets it to spin in to the southpaw. He misses the line of the delivery and so does Bairstow as it goes through him towards fine leg and the batters take one. The ball also misses the stumps by a whisker.
Outside off, Paine looks to drive but misses.
Paine looks to defend off the back foot but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.

This time on a good length, Starc goes for the drive and edges it. The ball goes between third slip and gully. The man in the deep stops it and the batters take one. Starc is off the mark with this one.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Starc.
Mitchell Starc is the new man in for the visitors. He is promoted up the order ahead of Pat Cummins.

OUT! A stunner from Bairstow behind the wicket to send Wade packing. Fullish ball outside off, shaping away. Wade is looking for quick runs and hence he throws his bat at the ball. He can only manage an outside edge which goes to the left of Bairstow. He dives to his left and holds onto it with one hand. A handy knock from Wade comes to an end. However, no declaration from Australia.
Fuller ball around off, Paine drives it towards cover and takes off for the run. Roy at covers dives to his right and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Paine had made his ground though.
FOUR! Fuller ball this time. Wade leans into the drive and carves this through the covers to get another boundary.
Flatter ball, turning into the batter this time, Wade goes back and punches it through covers to get a couple.
Short ball outside off, turns further away. Paine drives this through cover-point to get off the mark with the single.
Flighted ball around off, Paine pushes this back to the bowler.
Wade dances down the track to punch it through mid on for a single to this loopy full ball.
Skipper Tim Paine into the middle for the visitors.

OUT! CAUGHT! Smith is out of here after setting Australia well on their way! One can say that this was a suicidal shot but Smith wanted to up the ante of the game. Leach tosses it up way outside off, Smith comes down the track in an attempt to go over the man at long off. He does not get to the pitch of the ball and does not get the best connection on it. Stokes runs to his left from long off and takes an easy catch in the deep. The crowd breathe a huge sigh of relief as the main man is out of here.
Jack Leach into the attack now. Stuart Broad was seen heading into the dressing room.
Bouncer to Wade but he does well to evade it.
Good yorker by Archer, on the pads of Smith, he flicks it towards square leg and takes a single.
On the leg pole line by Archer, Smith shuffles and tries to flick but misses as the ball goes over the leg pole.
Bouncer by Archer and Smith is on the ground in an attempt to evade it. Even though he is on the ground, he does not stop practicing his strokes as he is shadowing how to play the upper cut.
Full and wide outside off, Wade pushes this towards cover and takes a single.
Good length ball on the off pole. Wade blocks it out.

DRINKS! Steven Smith marches on. There is none stopping him. Matthew Wade has done enough in the 100-run unbeaten stand to take the game away from the hosts. Smith is closing in towards yet another ton. And one would guess that the declaration will come around that ton, if that happens. Interesting final hour of the play awaits.

FOUR! Smith brings up the 100-run stand up between him and Wade. Another short of a length ball by Broad, Smith rocks onto the back foot and pulls this one towards long on for a boundary. Smith moves to 81 with this boundary. Another century on the cards? Most probably!
Fullish ball on off, Wade pushes this down the ground. Broad gets his hand on that as the ball goes to mid off and the batters take one.
On the pads of Wade, he flicks it but straight to the man.
On the pads of Smith, he flicks it towards fine leg and takes a single.
FIVE WIDES! Bad ball from Broad or mind games from Smith? Well, only Broad would know! He bowls it way down the leg side and it has evaded Bairstow to crash into the fine leg fence.

FOUR! Pulled away handsomely! Smith is looking from another planet right now. Short of a length and outside off, Smith pulls this wide of mid-wicket for a boundary. Root inside the circle dives to his right but cannot save the boundary.
Smith moves way down the leg side to play at that and pushes it towards mid on.n.
Some work at the bowlers landing area again. It is getting hammered and the white lines are painted back. Shane Warne on air feels this could be a tactics from England to waste some time.
Wide outside off, Wade guides it to third man.
Short of a length, Smith cuts it towards point and takes a single.
Another bouncer by Archer, Smith goes towards the ball and again leaves it at the last moment.
Another bouncer over middle and leg, Smith ducks under it.
Another bouncer, this time way outside off. Smith goes towards the ball and then ducks under it.
Short of a length by Archer, Smith blocks it awkwardly towards short leg.
Shorter in length this time, Wade pulls this through square leg and takes a couple.
Smith punches this towards point off the back foot and takes a single.
FOUR! Good length ball on middle and leg, Smith slaps this over Mid on and gets a boundary off it. He didn't time it that well and that's why it went to the long on fence on the bounce.
Full and wide outside off, Smith drives this powerfully towards cover but straight to the man.
On the pads of Wade, he flicks it towards fine leg and takes a single.
Wade pushes this fuller one towards mid on.
On the pads of Smith, he flicks it towards the leg side.
Smith plays another one awkwardly. This time it is a slower bouncer, Smith crouches and plays it at the last moment back towards Archer.
Another bouncer, Smith ducks under it.
Bouncer by Archer to Smith, he initially looks to play at it but leaves it in the end.

FOUR! Smith seems to be playing with the bowler's mind here. Archer bowls this length ball closer to the body expecting that Smith would shuffle across the stumps. Instead, he makes room and guides this past the third slip fielder for a boundary towards third man.
FOUR! Length ball just outside off, Smith gets onto the back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Jofra Archer to replace Jack Leach.
Good length around off, Smith taps it towards point for a single. He hared for the first run and wanted the second but Wade at the other end was ball watching.
Fuller ball on middle, blocked nicely this time towards the off side.
Good length ball, angled into the batter, blocked off the front foot this time.
FOUR! Crunched through the covers! There is no stopping Steven Smith. Broad dishes a fuller ball outside off, Smith leans into his drive and creams this through the covers.
Shortish ball on middle, Wade looks to heave this over the mid-wicket but the ball goes off the toe end of his bat. A single taken.
Good length ball on off, blocked comfortably.
The batsman dances down the track and they have run through for a single.

NOT OUT! England lose a review! Tossed up outside off, Wade goes for the sweep and misses. The England players go up in appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Wade had signalled for the review even before the umpire denied England's appeal showing that it had not hit him anywhere on the glove or the bat. England however, think that it has hit him on the glove and they go for the review. The replays roll in and show that it has hit him on the forearm. The umpire wants to check for the LBW and thus the Ball Tracker comes in. The impact is outside off and Wade easily survives. No wonder he was as confident as it seemed even before the appeal was made.
Review time! An appeal for a catch has been taken upstairs. Wade is the man in question. He seems relaxed.
This time outside off, Smith guides this one towards backward point and takes a single.
On the pads of Smith, he flicks this one towards square leg and takes a couple.
Again Smith brings out the reverse sweep. Stokes premeditates it and it is straight into his hands.
Smith goes for the reverse sweep off the first ball of the over but misses.
Fullish ball again, tapped towards point.
Wide yorker this time. Wade looks to drive but he is late into the shot.
Fuller ball outside off, directed towards gully this time by Wade.
Fuller one on the pads, Wade flicks it straight to the mid-on fielder.
Good length ball outside off, tapped towards the off side.
FIFTY! Another one! A routine for this man. 26th Test half ton. Fuller ball around off, he taps it towards cover and takes off for a quick single to get to his milestone.

DROPPED! Stokes is the culprit this time! This one is tossed up outside off, Smith goes for the reverse sweep and plays it uppishly. Stokes premeditates it and moves to his right from first slip before Smith had completed the shot. It went high and just towards the right of Stokes, he gets both his hands to it but the ball bursts through it. The ball rolls towards third man and the batters take a single. The main man for Australia survives and with this single, the lead for Australia has touched the 300-run mark.
Wade has swept that one through the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wade again tries to sweep but misses to get hit on the pad.
Wade sweeps this one but straight to the man at square leg.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Smith pushes it towards squarish mid-wicket and takes a single.
FOUR! Good improvisation by Smith. This is way down the leg side, Smith paddles this one very fine and the ball races through to the fine leg fence. 100 runs up for Australia in this innings.
Length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full length ball on off, pushed to mid on.
Good length ball on middle and off, Smith tries to push this towards the off side but gets an inside edge on it. The ball rolls towards fine leg and the batters take one.
FOUR! Fuller and on the pads, Smith flicks it awkwardly through mid-wicket for a boundary. His methods might be awkward but he is getting the desired result.
Smith defends this length ball  off the back foot.

Lucky, very Lucky is Smith! Broad is on the money from the ball one of his new spell. He dishes a full ball which shapes back in. Smith looks to flick it but gets and inside edge which goes very close to the leg stump . He wanted a single but after seeing haring Bairstow from behind the wicket decided against it. Bairstow comes across and breaks the stumps but Smith was in anyway.
Stuart Broad back into the attack. He was terrific in his first spell.
Wade tried to sweep that one but missed it and was hit on the pads.
This time Wade goes for the reverse sweep but even he misses it and is hit on the body.
Tossed up outside off, Smith opens the face of his bat awkwardly and guides this towards point to take a single.
Floated delivery outside the leg pole, Smith goes for the reverse sweep but misses.
This time it pitches outside leg and spins towards middle. Smith blocks it out.
Tossed up on leg pole, defended out.
BOUNCER! Overton goes short and Wade is spot on to sight that early and ducks under it.
Wade defends this length ball off his back foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
Wade defends this length ball outside off on the off side.

FOUR! Beautifully done! Wade has played a gorgeous square cut. Overton bowls on a length and outside off, Wade frees his arms and cuts it through point for a magnificent boundary. That should give some confidence to Wade.
On a length and on the pads, Smith flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Wade looks to work this flatter one towards the leg side but gets it off the inside half of his bat towards short fine leg.
Flighted on middle and leg, Wade looks to flick it off his pads but misses it.
Wade defends this flighted one by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter one outside off, Smith drives it to long off and gets to the other end.
FOUR! Tossed up and outside off, Smith gets down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Smith defends this flatter one by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wade defends this length ball outside off to point.
Length and outside off, Wade looks to run this down to third man but the fielder inside the circle cuts it off.
Smith works this length ball outside off towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short on middle and Wade swivels to pulls it over mid-wicket but can't get his timing right. However, the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket and the batters take three in the meantime.
Length ball and outside off, Wade  defends it to the off side.
On a length and around off, Wade defends it to mid on.
Wade flicks this flighted one off his pads to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, Wade looks to defend it to the off side but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Flighted on off, Smith works it to mid on and takes a single.
Tossed up on leg, Wade flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one on middle and leg, Wade defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery on off, Smith plays it to point and gets off strike.
Wade defends this back of a length ball outside off to point.
Fuller one on off, Wade drives it to the man at mid off.
BEATEN! Back of a length and outside off, Wade gets away from the line of the delivery to let it pass through.
Good length delivery outside off, Wade defends it off the outside half of his bat to gully.
Length ball and on off, Wade crouches low as he defends it onto the pitch.
On a length and on off, Wade drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Craig Overton to continue after the break from the other end.

In the air... but safe! Smith once again steps out but this time does not get to the pitch of it. He still goes ahead with the shot, ends up mistiming it over the mid off fielder for two. 10 from the first over after Tea.
On middle, it is kept out.

Flighted ball, it turns and bounces extra as Wade looks to work it down the leg side. But because of the turn and bounce he can't put bat on ball. It goes towards fine leg. Smith calls for a single but Wade is late in taking off. The fine leg fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A direct hit would've had Wade in trouble.

Three now! Expects this one to be shorter and wider and it is like that. Smith stays right back and leg side of the ball, guides it down to third man for three. Overton chases the ball and pulls it back with a slide.

FOUR! Hammered! That is an aggressive shot from Smith. Australia going to go all guns blazing after the break? Maybe. Smith steps down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball and hammers it down to the long on fence.
Floats it up on off, Smith drives it with the turn to covers. Roy makes a good stop diving to his right.

The hosts are back out in the middle after the Tea break. The Australian batters, Steven Smith and Matthew Wade are also on the field and it will be interesting to see what their approach will be in this session. Jack Leach to continue the proceedings for England. The last session on Day 4 is underway...
... Day 4, Session 3 ...

For Australia, once again it is Smith who has held one end up. The others had no answers to the fiery spells by Broad and Archer. However, the lead is already 259 and Wade and Smith will hope they can stitch a good stand here. 42 overs left in the day, will we see England bat today? Stay tuned to find out.

An excellent session of play for England but still it is Australia who are ahead in the game! England, after losing their last two wickets quickly earlier in the session, needed to come out all guns blazing and their bowlers did so. They put the onus of wicket-taking on their two best bowlers and Broad and Archer delivered. Both bowled 9-over spells and dismantled the Australian top order. They need to keep doing that as England know, that one good partnership can take the game away from them.
This time Overton brings it a bit closer to the stumps and Wade just plays it to point. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 4!
Length and outside off, Wade lets it go through to the keeper.
Good ball this from Overton. He bowls one on a length and outside off, But the ball climbs onto the batsmen and Wade at the last minute sways away from the line of the delivery.
Length and on middle, Smith flicks it off his pads towards fine leg for a single.
Once again Smith is happy to defend this length ball outside off towards the off side.
Overton bowls on a length and outside off, Smith defends by coming right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up delivery on off, Smith punches this towards mid off for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Wade flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

Superb effort by Jofra in the outfield! Loopy delivery on the pads, Smith dances down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket. Jofra in the deep puts in a dive to pull the ball back. He does that but the ball continues to roll towards the fence. He leaps again to save a run as the batters take three.
Turn and bounce! Leach bowls one outside off and Smith dabs it to point.
Flighted delivery outside off, Wade sweeps it through square leg and gets a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Wade paddles it down towards fine leg and gets couple.
Spin time! Jack Leach into the attack now.
Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Smith flicks it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Back of a length on the pads,  Smith hops and flicks it to fine leg and gets a couple.
Bouncer! Smith ducks under it.
Fuller one outside off, Wade drives it towards covers and crosses over for a quick single.
Fuller one on the pads, Smith flicks it off his pads to fine leg and gets to the other end.
Length ball around off, Smith plays it off the back foot towards mid on.
Craig Overton is on now! End of the marathon spell by Broad.
Shorter in length and on the body, Wade ducks under it.
This is angled into the middle pole, Wade gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Outside off, it is left alone.
Two taken! Fuller and around off, Wade strokes it through covers and runs a brace.
Shorter and outside off, it is left alone.
This is angled into the pads, Smith works it wide of mid on for one. 600 runs for Smith in Ashes 2019 so far.
Last ball of the over, pushed to the man at cover.
Another one on the pads, Wade tucks this straight to the man at mid-wicket.
On the pads of Wade, he flicks it towards fine leg and takes a couple. The fielder in the deep fumbled but no harm done.
Length ball around off, Wade looks to defend this off the back foot but gets beaten.

Questionnaire - 'Australia 4 down! Well, the quicker they get bowled out, England will be all out even quicker!' @Questionnaire - Given your name, interesting that you are making a statement rather than asking a question.
Good length ball around off, Wade opens the face of his bat and guides this towards gully.
Length ball around off, Wade shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Way down the leg side by Archer, Smith goes after it and misses his flick.

Fiery again! On the pads of Wade, he flicks it towards fine leg for a single. Wade, when taking his single almost clashed with Archer. So Archer in return, while Wade took a start for the second, stood his ground which means he was right in front of Wade. The batter opts not to go around him, turns and goes back to his crease. There though wasn't two on there. Wade is off the mark with this single.
Bouncer again! This time down the leg side and Wade ducks under it.
Full length ball on middle and off, Wade pushes this towards cover-point.
Bouncer this time outside off, Wade sways away from it.
On the pads of Wade, he flicks it towards fine leg.
Fuller around off this time, Smith blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off, left alone by Smith.
Bumper again from Broad. But this goes down the leg side. Smith lets it go the keeper.
Fuller ball this time, Smith blocks by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Good length ball on middle, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Bumper but too high. Smith ducks under it.
Matthew Wade is the new man in for the Aussies.

OUT! The middle stump takes a walk! What a jaffa from Archer! England are all over the visitors. Fuller length on middle, comes into the batter. Head looks to go for the drive but he has played all over this delivery. The ball sneaks through and shatters the timber behind. Wicket number two for Archer. Australia 240 ahead with 6 wickets in hand. Smith is watching all the damage from the other end.
FOUR! Top shot. Fullish length, there's room on offer for Head. He leans into the drive and powers it through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on the body this time, Head does well to fend it off towards the slip cordon.
Shortish ball on middle, angled into the body. Head looks to work it down the leg side but is hit on the thigh pad.
Good length ball around off again. Head looks to drive through covers but the ball takes the bottom edge and  goes towards Archer.
In the channel outside off, Head lets it go to the keeper.
FOUR! Smith is not bothered about what is happening around. Good length ball outside off, enough room for Smith to carve the cover drive for a boundary.
On the pads on a good length, Head nudges it fine down the leg side for a single.
Good length around off, tapped towards point this time.

Good length ball on middle and leg, nips back further. Head looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Broad appeals but nothing from the umpire. No review from England. A good call as the Ball Tracker rolled in to show that this was going down the leg side.
Shortish ball around off, Head looks to punch off the back foot but the ball goes off the toe end of the bat towards extra cover.
Fuller ball on off. Head drives it straight to cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Edged but doesn't carry. Fuller ball, outside off, Head throws his bat at it to get an outside edge towards the slip cordon. It is wide of the diving slip fielder.
Another shortish ball around off, Head looks to work it down the leg side but it goes off the outer half of the bat.

You look at the scorecard and get the feeling, Wow. This is now an exciting Test match. Let Broad and Archer rip through the Aussies. However, the most important bowlers are not necessarily the ones making the inroads at the start. They are those who follow them up. Broad and Archer cannot bowl forever and it is important that the likes of Stokes, Overton and Leach compliment the duo.
Shortish length ball on middle, tucked towards the leg side for a couple this time.
FOUR! Crunched! Overpitched by Archer and Head lifts this over cover-point to get off the mark with a boundary. Archer won't mind this as the batter seems to be ready to drive the ball outside off.
Good length ball on off, angled into the batter, Head taps it towards cover off the back foot.
A dot to end! Fuller and on middle, this is hit to mid on.
Another top nut! This is a brilliant spell by Broad. Shorter and around off, it straightens after pitching. Smith tries to defend but gets beaten.
Outside off, this is left alone.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! There was a run opportunity there. A direct hit would have been close. A short one which hurries onto Smith. He mistimes the pull towards square leg. Head wants a run and sets off. Smith takes a start and then sends him back. The fielder from mid-wicket gets to the ball and then throws it as he turns towards the non-striker's end. He misses. Archer fails to collect the ball as it bounces in front of him and it goes to the long off fence. England can't give away such free runs.

Excellent usage of the length by the English seamers. They have understood that the pitch has slowed down quite a lot and hence, the bounce is not as much as it was on the first three days. All the three LBW dismissals which we have witnessed so far in this innings, would have been going over the top in the first dig.
This is down the leg side, the batter looks to flick but misses.
BEATEN! This is angled into the off pole, it pitches and straightens. Smith looks to defend but is beaten.
Bumper this time. Head ducks under it. End of a superb over from Archer.
Another fullish ball, Head pushed it towards the off side.
Fuller ball again, outside off, beats the outside edge again.
Travis Head is the next man in for the visitors. He needs to stay patient and give Smith some assistance.

OUT! That looked dead plumb! Marnus knew it as soon as he was hit on the pads. England are on fire! This time it is Jofra Archer. Fuller and straight this time. Marnus looks to defend but the ball shapes in late to miss the forward block. He is hit on the pads. Archer and England make a loud appeal along with the crowd. The umpire agrees and sends him packing. He though consults with Smith and eventually goes for the review. This looks close, very close. The Ultra Edge shows no spike. Height maybe? Here comes the Ball Tracker. It shows that the ball was just clipping the top of middle. They retain the review but Marnus is a goner. No half ton for him here, first time it has happened for him in this Ashes. Australia in all sorts of trouble early on.
REVIEW TIME! Australia have again gone for the review. This time Labuschagne is the man in question.
Gets closer this time on a good length. Marnus blunts it towards mid off by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Good length in the channel outside off, Marnus lets it go to the keeper.

Punter also observes the confidence in Smith's batting. Though he questions as well - Is that confidence or the team's orders? Because he can already see plenty of shots being played by Smith in this innings, when he has just arrived.
That is a brave, brave leave! This is fuller and outside off, it comes in. Smith leaves it and it goes just past the off pole.
Shorter and outside off, Smith mistimes his cut to point.
Cut him into half! This lands outside off and then jags back in. Smith looks to put bat on ball but is beaten.
England have got a catching mid-wicket. Could be a bit straighter.
Outside off, it is left alone.
Down the leg side, Smith looks to flick but misses.

Interesting... Ricky Ponting on air observes the reaction of Steven Smith after he played that shot. He says that Smudge indicated as if the ball held up on the wicket. Punter though, opines that he is not too sure that the ball held up. Hmmmm...
Just short! Fuller and on middle, Smith looks to drive but the ball sticks in the surface. It goes uppishly but well short of mid on.

Amit The Mastermind - 'Dear commentator, how on earth do you think that England can win from here? That too with Lyon in the opposition? He will spin a web around them. I am seeing only two results from here - Draw or Australia win.' @ATM - Well, alright. Just extracting all the possibilities, you see...
Length ball outside off, Labuschagne rises on his toes to defend that into the ground towards the off side.
FOUR! Back of a length and outside off, Labuschagne opens the face of his bat at the last moment and runs it down to third man. The ball crosses the fence to hand a boundary to Australia and Marnus.

BEATEN! Good ball by Archer. He bowls one in the channel of uncertainty and Marnus gets sucked into poking at it. But luckily for him the ball goes past the outside edge and into the mitts of the keeper.
Fuller one around off, Marnus defends it towards the off side.
Length ball outside off, Labuschagne shoulders arms to it.
Length ball outside off, Marnus drives it through covers for a couple.

Smith is off the mark! Broad bowls one full and outside off, Smith looks to stroke it through the off side but then tries to bail out. Too late as the ball hits the bat and rolls through covers for two.

Amit The Mastermind - 'Hmmm... now this Test is interesting. What a bowling spell by Broady. Superb. I feel if England can stop Australia from scoring, they can at least draw this Test. Don't think they can win from here.' @ATM - Erm... with Stokesy in the side, they can do ANYTHING. Don't think runs are a matter in this Test tbh. Australia would be wanting to bat two sessions, just to give their bowlers some rest. Now, it is a different issue whether their bowlers can forget the ghosts of Headingley...
This is angled into the batter, Smith works it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, Smith strokes it nicely to covers.
That stays low! Well played in the end! This is on off, it skids through. Smith gets his bat down in time and keeps it out. That just shows how carefully Smith watches the ball.
Outside off, it is left alone.
Steven Smith is the new man in. He barely got 6 overs to put his feet up. Here he is again, needed to resurrect the innings for his team.

OUT! Three reds and Harris is a goner! A waste of a review to be honest, that looked out. This is almost a carbon copy of how Harris got out in the first innings. Broad comes steaming in from around the wicket just like he did in the first innings. He lands it on off and it is slightly fuller, it jags back in. Harris looks to play it with a straight bat but misses and is hit flush on the front pad. An appeal and up goes the finger. Marcus walks up to his partner and after a chat reviews. Replays roll in and they show that the on-field call is the right one. Australia lose a review. Things going good for England at the moment.
REVIEW TIME! Umpire Erasmus has adjudged Harris out LBW! It looks plumb to the naked eye but after a chat with his partner, Harris has gone for it.
Well bowled and nicely played in the end! Shortish and just outside off, Marnus looks to defend but then there is extra bounce. He does well to drop his hands and lets it go.
Back of a length and on off, Labuschagne keeps it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a good length and around off, Marnus goes back and keeps it out.
Outside off, this one is left alone.
Back of a length on off, it is kept out.
On the pads of Labuschagne, he flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Marnus has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Superb shot! This is a fullish ball outside off, Labuschagne slaps this through covers for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length ball outside off, Harris looks to push this towards the off side but gets an inside edge on it. It goes past the leg pole and towards fine leg for a single.

FOUR BYES! Too much movement on that one! It pitches outside off, and starts to come back in with the angle. It goes down the leg side, Harris leaves it and it goes even further away from the keeper. Bairstow's dive cannot stop the ball and it goes to the fine leg fence.
Good length ball wide outside off, Harris fends at it but gets an outside edge at it which goes on the bounce towards gully. It goes past the diving fielder and they take a single.
Length ball just outside off by Jofra, it pitches and nips away. Harris looks to defend first but then bails out.
Harris defends this one by presenting the full face of the bat.
Length ball on the body, Harris tucks it towards the leg side and looks for a single but Labuschagne opts against it.
FOUR! Great reply by Harris! Full and on the pads, Harris drives this one wide of mid on and the ball has raced towards the fence.
OUCH! That one must have hurt Harris. Length ball just outside off, comes in with the angle. Harris looks to push this one towards the on side but misses and is hit on the box.
Fuller ball again, gets behind the line to block. Back-to-back maiden from Broad.
Fuller and closer to the off pole, Marnus lunges to block it well.

Shortish length ball on off, Labuschagne taps it towards cover and looks for a run. But the fielder is quick at ball. Seeing that Marnus return to his crease. The fielder has a shy at the stumps but misses. He was in anyway.
Slightly fuller and on middle, Marnus gets one hand off the bat handle to drop it towards the leg side with soft hands.
In the channel again and on a good length. Marnus lets it go the keeper again.
Good length ball outside off, Marnus lets it go to the keeper.
Fuller ball around off, Harris leans into the drive to cream this through covers but Roy does well to save a boundary.
Beats the outside edge again! Another good length ball in the channel, shapes away from Harris' poke to beat the outside edge.
No ball! Bouncer but it is too high. Harris ducks under it. However, Jofra has overstepped.
Good length ball, angled into the batter from off and middle, blocked towards the leg side this time.
Good length ball this time, Harris covers his stumps and lets it go to keeper.
Beaten! Goes past the outside edge this time. This is closer to the off pole. It is pitched on off, and shapes away from Harris. He looks to fend it away but misses.
Fuller ball around off, tapped towards mid off by Harris.
Marnus Labuschagne is the new man in for Australia. Jofra Archer to share the attack with Broad from the other end.

OUT! LBW! Warner is out of here and Broad is the man who has got him again! HIS 300TH TEST WICKET IN ENGLAND. This one is on a good length and just outside off, it comes in with the angle. Warner tries to block it out but misses and he is hit high on the pad. The English players go for the appeal in unison and the umpire gives it out. Warner has a chat with his partner at the non-striker's end but Harris tells him there is no use of taking the review. Ball Tracker comes in and confirms it as it shows three reds. Three consecutive ducks for Warner now and he is in a rough patch of form.
BEATEN! Warner picked that bouncer up very late. He initially looks to play at it but bails out in the end.

Fiery! Good ball on middle and off, Warner blocks it back towards Broad. He fakes a throw at the stumps and Warner rushes back into the crease. Warner and Broad have a stare at each other first but then exchange smiles in the end.
On middle and leg this time, Warner takes a step down the track and pushes it towards mid on.
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards point.
Broad starts off with a good length ball way outside off, Warner leaves it alone. He will be looking to get him out for the second time in this match.
